report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 propagating from order 502, which stems from payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory/redis calls succeed. Gateway metrics confirm checkout 502s with low latency (~94ms p95), ruling out latency. Root cause is bounded to the payment dependency, but payment-side evidence is absent, so the specific payment fault is unconfirmed.
